card.name: Mundo Toon
card.summary: Pague 1.000 PV para ativar esta Magia Contínua.

textEvidence.text: Toon World is a Continuous Spell. Pay 1000 LP when activating it. The cost is paid before either player can respond and is not refunded if the activation is negated or the spell is destroyed. It stays face-up in a Spell/Trap Zone after successful resolution and has no other printed effect. It is not a Field Spell and does not create or give any Toon monster.

card.name: Dragão Metal Raro
card.summary: Não pode ser Invocado por Invocação-Normal nem baixado da mão.

textEvidence.text: Rare Metal Dragon cannot be Normal Summoned or Normal Set. This is a summoning restriction, not an activated effect. A card effect can Special Summon it from a permitted zone without a prior proper summon. Skill Drain on the field does not allow the controller to Normal Summon the card in hand.

card.name: Gaia, o Cavaleiro Impetuoso Célere
card.summary: Se for sua única carta na mão, pode Invocá-la normalmente em Ataque sem Tributos.

textEvidence.text: Swift Gaia the Fierce Knight can be Normal Summoned in Attack Position with no Tributes when it is the only card in its controller’s hand. The procedure does not start a Chain, does not grant an extra summon, and does not permit Set without Tributes. Ordinary Tribute Summon and Tribute Set remain possible. Field effect negation does not negate the choice made from hand.
